text: Rhys starts at the council on 2 November 2026, first day nerves already. Text him good luck the Sunday night before.
salma op moved to thurs 8am, she's ok about it but her mum is a wreck
Saskia's leaving do is Friday at 6 at the Crown. Chipping in for the card, need to give Helen a tenner by Wednesday.
Kai got the promotion!! team lead from January. Afua says he's been grinning all week

So Niamh rang this morning and her dad's having his hip done on the 12th at half 9, at the Royal. She's taking the week off to look after him and sounded pretty frazzled, tbh. Her brother Kieran is meant to be helping but lives in Leeds. I should drop round some food that weekend and maybe ring her the evening after the op to see how it went.
ravi retiring march 2027 after 31 yrs at the depot. wants a proper send off apparently
Varun and Lila are flying to Lisbon tomorrow morning for their anniversary. Back the following Tuesday.
Isabel is vegetarian, doesn't drink, loves bouldering.
Darius - new job at the hospital trust, band 6, starts after christmas. still living with his cousin in Hackney
Pick up prescription and post the parcel before the post office shuts at 1 Saturday.
Call Tunde tomorrow evening about the van for the move.
Eva had the scan last Monday, results came back fine. Should send her a message, she was really anxious beforehand.
Amir's interview at Rolls-Royce is on 4 December 2026 at 10am. He's bricking it. Don't forget to wish him luck that morning.
pedro: knee surgery went ok, home since sunday, on crutches 6 wks. bored out of his mind
Astrid mentioned she's been eyeing up a decent pair of walking boots, Christmas idea maybe
Luca's last day at the bakery was yesterday. Opening his own place in the spring.

rana and her husband are moving to cardiff end of jan, he got a transfer with the bank. she's gutted to leave her job tho, been there 8 yrs and just got promoted in the summer. looking at teaching assistant roles down there. leaving do probs mid jan, she said she'll message the group. their son starts at the new school after feb half term
Dafydd Evans, Daf to everyone, just made partner at the firm. Drinks on the 21st at 7.

Kwame's mum is in hospital again, chest infection, second time since the summer. He's driving up to Birmingham this weekend to sit with her and sort out the carers with his sister. Sounded exhausted on the phone, said work have been decent about it at least. Check in with him Monday evening once he's back, and maybe offer to have the kids Saturday if he needs it.
archie's dog Biscuit had his op on tues, all fine, wearing the cone of shame
Fatima has her driving test next Thursday at 2:40. Third attempt so she's quite nervous about it.
Yosef's wife Mariam is due in February. First baby. They've not picked names yet, he says she wants something short.
Note to self - book GP appointment for the 30th, morning if poss
Hoang texted. Redundancy consultation is on Wednesday at 11. Doesn't know if he'll keep his job. I need to call him Wednesday afternoon.
Noah's starting his apprenticeship 9 November 2026, electrician. Georgia says he's dead excited
mia's cataract op got cancelled, hospital rescheduled for 15 Jan 2027 at 8.15. she's annoyed, already had the time off booked
Dinner with Kieran and Saskia on Saturday cancelled, Saskia's got covid. Rebook for later in the month.
Helen Wright - started as head of HR at the uni in September. Two kids, Oscar and Ivy. Lives out near Shrewsbury.
Rhys mentioned his sister Eva is having her gallbladder out sometime in November. He's taking her in.
Remember to send Salma the link to that physio Pedro used.

Voice note. Afua called, she's finally handed in her notice, last day is the 28th of November. New place is in Manchester, starting 1 December 2026. She's nervous about the commute and the money's not that much better but she's been miserable for ages. Leaving drinks probably the Friday before. Get her something small, she's always on about wanting a proper coffee grinder.
Kai and his partner Lila have their housewarming Saturday 14th from 4ish. I'm bringing dessert.

Ravi's back in for more tests on Tuesday at 9, bloods and another MRI this time. Still no diagnosis after nearly three months and he's really low about it, says he's stopped telling people at work because it's easier. His wife's going in with him. Must ring him Tuesday night after, and not just to ask about results.
Varun finished his probation, permanent now. Celebrating Friday.
Tunde hates surprises, doesn't like fuss for his bday either
meeting Isabel for coffee Thurs 10.30 at the usual place, she wants advice on going freelance
Niamh says her nan passed away last week. Funeral is on 3 November 2026 at 2pm in Galway. She's flying out the Sunday.
Amir got the job!!! starts in January. Send congrats

Astrid update: Dr Santos told her the recovery's going slower than expected after the shoulder op in August. Physio twice a week now, Mondays and Thursdays at 5. She's frustrated, can't drive till March 2027 and has had to go part time. Her husband's doing all the school runs. Offered to give her lifts to physio on Thursdays, she said she'd let me know.
so, Darius and Rana are getting married next August, engagement party on 7 November at their place, 7pm. need to RSVP by Friday and figure out a present
Ring the garage about the MOT tomorrow morning, then do the big shop.
Pedro's brother Luca has just been made assistant manager at the gym. Pedro's well proud.
Uncle Kwame retires end of this month after 40 years on the buses. Party on the 31st at half 7 at the social club. Family are chipping in for a watch. Ask Fatima how much everyone's putting in.
Yosef is coeliac, so no bakery stuff for the meeting.

Hoang Zhou rang back about the consultation. Kept his job in the end, but two of his team didn't, including Kai who'd been there longest. Hoang feels pretty awful about it, survivor's guilt he called it. Their last day is the 30th and he wants to organise something for them. Might take him for a pint next week, maybe Thursday after work.

Mia's knee replacement is finally booked for 19 March 2027 at 7.30am, so she'll miss the walking trip in April which she's sad about. Her daughter Lila is coming over from Spain to stay with her for a fortnight after. Mia's a bit scared, last op didn't go smoothly. I'm driving her to the pre-op on 1 March.

Bumped into Georgia in town. Her boyfriend Archie has his first day as a junior doctor on Wednesday, 7am start on a surgical ward. She says he barely slept last night and keeps rereading his notes. His parents are coming down for the weekend after to celebrate. Text him Wednesday evening to see how it went, and remind Noah too because they were at uni together.
lunch w Noah tues 1pm
Saskia's dad came out of hospital this afternoon after the stent. Doing ok, she says. She's back at work Monday.
Helen loves crime podcasts and wild swimming. Has a cat called Pickle.
Rhys Kumar's presentation to the board is next Friday at 3pm. He's been prepping for weeks. Ask him how it went over the weekend.
Salma's daughter starts nursery on Monday, Salma's more nervous than the kid lol

Called Eva back. She got offered the senior role but it means relocating to Bristol by spring 2027. Hasn't decided yet. Her partner Dafydd is keen, she's less sure. They're going to view a few flats down there on the 22nd and 23rd.
Kieran said his mum's eye appointment is tomorrow at 4. He's taking her.
Book table for 6 on Saturday at 8 for my birthday.
Lila mentioned her boss is retiring in December and she might go for the role. Don't forget to ask her about it in the new year.
Varun Singh - old uni friend, now a pharmacist in Leicester. Into cycling and board games. Two kids.

Talked to Isabel's mum at the school gate. Isabel's had her appendix out, in hospital since Saturday night, should be home by Thursday. I should send flowers to the house tomorrow and then pop round at the weekend once she's settled, maybe Sunday afternoon.
Tunde's back at work on Monday after the hernia op. Light duties for a month.
Don't forget to post Mariam the baby clothes before the 2nd.
